releaseNotes: Fix: swipe gestures always measured zero displacement. pollTouch() only re-sampled the touch position on the not-pressed->pressed transition, so a finger that moved while still down (a genuine swipe) was never re-tracked -- the release event always resent the ORIGINAL touch-down position, making every swipe look like a zero-distance tap to the host. Position is now sampled on every loop() iteration while the finger is down, so release reflects wherever it actually was just before lifting off.
